title: Implementation of Ethically Aligned Design with Ethical User stories in SMART terminal Digitalization project: Use case Passenger Flow
reasoning: The entire paper is dedicated to the study and implementation of 'Ethically Aligned Design' (EAD) and 'Ethical User Stories' in AI development. It evaluates how specific ethical principles (transparency, accountability, safety, and data privacy) are translated into practical software requirements for a maritime digitalization project.
